{{Top}}
[[File:Eaw_Yavin.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The gas giant Yavin Prime]]
{{Quote|The second most common type planet are huge gas giants, with poisonous atmospheres at pressures so great that starships are easily crushed.|[[Bureau of Scouting and Exploration Services|New Republic Scout Service]] ''[[Spaceguide]]''|<ref name="Galaxy Guide 8: Scouts">''[[Galaxy Guide 8: Scouts]]''</ref>}}
A '''gas giant''' was a type of [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was primarily made up of gaseous layers. Most were made primarily of [[Hydrogen/Legends|hydrogen]] and [[Helium/Legends|helium]], with some [[Methane/Legends|methane]]; a rare few had [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]]-rich layers within their [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheres]] which were capable of supporting a [[Life Zone/Legends|life zone]]. Gas giants usually had many [[Moon/Legends|moons]] due to their high mass and gravity, and some also possessed spectacular systems of [[Planetary ring/Legends|planetary rings]]. Some gas giants included [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]], [[Taloraan/Legends|Taloraan]], [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin Prime]], and [[Oovo]].<ref name="POTG">''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume One]]''</ref>

The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] had classified gas giants based on a type gas giant such as [[Bespin-class gas giant|''Bespin''-class gas giants]]. The two two gas giants in the [[Horuz system/Legends|Horuz system]] where ''Bespin''-class gas giants.<ref name="DS">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref> A type of gas giant were the Jovian planets.<ref name="SWTRPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>
